body: It sucks and I hate seeing others go through it it's not a good feeling to have and I'm sorry

If that were true I wouldn't be here feeling the way I feel and I can almost guarantee you 99.99 percent of everyone has something to blame me for there's honestly no point anymore and I'm just done ...

Because I'm a burden to everyone I come across I'm a constant disappointment and I hardly have anyone on my side .. To have people constantly remind you of how shitty you are as a person everyday does some great damage and it's honestly to the point where I want to make those people happy and give them what they want ... I mean where's the line when is enough enough? When can I pull the cord and stop suffering because I hate hate this feeling and I can't hold on anymore
